requirements_summary:
Workload: agent-facing RAG + ticket summarization; real-time tool-calling for workflows.
Latency: p95 <= 250ms for agent assist, <500ms acceptable for summaries.
Throughput: baseline 20 QPS, peak bursts to 120 QPS for short windows.
Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; prefers predictable committed pricing for Dedicated pools.
Model preferences: open-models OK; likes 13B quantized for generation, 2-4B encoders for embeddings.
Retrieval: multi-source retrieval (Zendesk + Confluence + S3), freshness constraints (hourly ticket sync), provenance/citations mandatory.
Reliability: must sustain spikes via autoscaling + fallback smaller models; circuit-breaker and graceful degradation strategies required.
Security/Compliance: SSO/SCIM, SOC2, KMS integration, audit logs, EU data residency.
POC success metrics: Avg response latency, citation precision >= 85% on 500 eval prompts, cost per 1k tokens under target threshold.
